name: Thousand-Blade Volley
description: Critical Missile turns every crit into a seeking firework missile. Vulnerability supplies crit and lets item effects and damage-over-time crit too. Patch 26.15 lowers each missile's base damage, but this remains the core play; the build only pushes the missile and on-hit trigger rate to its limit.
playPattern: Secure Critical Missile and Vulnerability first, then enter the Fated Ashes, Triple Recurve build path. Constant attacks drive missiles, spread attacks, and item effects at the same time.

itemPlan.name: Fated Ashes, Triple Recurve
itemPlan.description: Thousand-Blade Volley's build play: hold Runaan's Hurricane, Infinity Edge, Fated Ashes, and three Recurve Bows, then choose the appropriate final build.

itemBranches.name: On-hit conversion
itemBranches.description: Convert the three Recurve Bows into Wit's End, Guinsoo's Rageblade, and Terminus to finish the high-frequency crit and item-effect build. Take this route for Thousand-Blade Volley.

itemBranches.name: Triple Burn
itemBranches.description: Turn the Recurve slots into Demonic Embrace and Liandry's Torment for three overlapping burn effects. It is the parallel finish to On-hit Conversion, not part of Thousand-Blade Volley.
